ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% dark pigmentation with negligible high-intensity white pixel distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch dividing the lobes with a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated profile consisting of multiple jagged peaks and shallow valleys across the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips of the fluke.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast heterogeneous clusters of white/brownish pixels localized specifically on the extreme distal tips (corners) of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of sessile organisms (barnacles) attached to the trailing edge margins at both the left and right distal tips.
